about.title: Our Story
about.headline: Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency,
about.description: Headquartered in Delhi, offices in Jaipur and Hyderabad, Reinvent Digital offers 360-degree digital marketing services, built around the outcome that matters most: patients who walk in.

sections.heading: From Ads to Walk-Ins, One Reliable Team for Every Step in Between
body: Reinvent Digital began in 2015, with healthcare as most of our work from day one. Our first client, a multi-location dental chain, grew from 60 to 400+ clinics with us.
But one gap kept coming back: clients wanted walk-ins, not just reports. So we went beyond marketing and built our Patient Acquisition System.
Our team runs it all: campaigns, Google Maps, calls, WhatsApp follow-up, CRM and reporting.
sections.highlight: One Team. One Dashboard. One Goal: The Patient Walk-Ins You Want.

founder.heading: If We Can't Prove the Number We Won't Show It To You
founder.body: When I started Reinvent Digital in 2015, I believed healthcare marketing deserved more than clicks and impressions. Clinic owners need to know how many patients walked in, and what each one cost.
